title: 庐山谣寄卢侍御虚舟
title_en: Song of Mount Lu, for Censor Lu Xuzhou
author: 李白

text_note.zh: 本库“回厓沓嶂”的“厓”，通行本写作“崖”，意思一样。这里用通行本。
text_note.en: Where the corpus writes the word for cliff (yá) in an old form, the taught text uses the modern character. The meaning is the same. We follow the taught text.

readings.en: In zhāo bié, "leave in the morning", it is read zhāo.
In zhāo rì, "the morning sun", it is read zhāo.

readings.zh: “朝玉京”是“去朝拜玉京”，读 cháo。
readings.en: In cháo yù jīng, "go to pay respects at the Jade Capital", it is read cháo.
In hào rù, "love to go into", it is read hào.
In hào wéi, "love to make", it is read hào.

readings.zh: 这里“傍”同“旁”，是“旁边”的意思，读 páng。也有书读 bàng（靠近）。
readings.en: Here it means the same as "beside" and is read páng. Some books read it bàng, "close to".

readings.zh: “二峰长”是两座山峰很高很长，读 cháng。
readings.en: In èr fēng cháng, "the two peaks stretch tall", it is read cháng.

readings.zh: “去不还”是“流走不回来”，读 huán，和“间、山”押韵。
readings.en: In qù bù huán, "flows away and never returns", it is read huán, rhyming with jiān and shān.
Here it means mood or delight, read xìng.
Here it means "buried, covered over", read mò.

readings.zh: “还丹”是道家炼的仙丹，读 huán。
readings.en: In huán dān, a Daoist elixir, it is read huán.

readings.zh: “沓嶂”是层层叠叠的山峰，“沓”读 tà。
readings.en: In tà zhàng, "layer upon layer of peaks", it is read tà.

glosses.zh: 楚狂人：春秋时楚国有个叫接舆的人，假装疯癫，不去做官。李白说自己就像他。
glosses.en: chǔ kuáng rén: the Madman of Chu, Jieyu, who lived in the Spring and Autumn period, pretended to be mad and refused to be an official. Li Bai says he is like him.

glosses.zh: 凤歌笑孔丘：接舆曾经唱着“凤兮凤兮”的歌经过孔子身边，嘲笑孔子到处奔走想做官。孔丘就是孔子。
glosses.en: fèng gē xiào kǒng qiū: Jieyu once walked past Confucius singing "Phoenix, oh phoenix", mocking him for rushing about looking for a post. Kong Qiu is Confucius's own name.

glosses.zh: 绿玉杖：用绿玉装饰的手杖，传说是仙人用的。
glosses.en: lǜ yù zhàng: a walking staff decorated with green jade, said to be carried by immortals.

glosses.zh: 黄鹤楼：有名的高楼，在今天湖北武汉的长江边。
glosses.en: Yellow Crane Tower: a famous tower by the Yangtze in today's Wuhan, Hubei.

glosses.zh: 五岳：中国五座有名的大山：东岳泰山、西岳华山、南岳衡山、北岳恒山、中岳嵩山。这里泛指天下名山。
glosses.en: the Five Great Mountains: Tai in the east, Hua in the west, Heng in the south, another Heng in the north, and Song in the center. Here it means all the famous mountains.

glosses.zh: 不辞远：不怕路远。
glosses.en: bù cí yuǎn: not minding how far it is.

glosses.zh: 秀出：高高地、美丽地挺立出来。
glosses.en: xiù chū: rising up tall and lovely.

glosses.zh: 南斗：星宿名，有六颗星。古人把天上的星和地上的地方对应，庐山一带对着南斗。
glosses.en: nán dǒu: the Southern Dipper, a group of six stars. People of old matched stars to places on earth; the Mount Lu area matched the Southern Dipper.

glosses.zh: 屏风九叠：庐山五老峰东北有九叠屏，山峰一层层像折起来的屏风。
glosses.en: píng fēng jiǔ dié: the Nine-Fold Screen of Mount Lu, northeast of Five Old Men Peak, where the cliffs stand in folds like a folding screen.

glosses.zh: 云锦张：像彩色的锦缎一样展开。锦：有花纹的丝织品。
glosses.en: yún jǐn zhāng: spread out like colorful brocade. Jǐn is silk woven with patterns.

glosses.zh: 明湖：明亮的湖，指庐山脚下的鄱阳湖。
glosses.en: míng hú: the bright lake, Lake Poyang at the foot of Mount Lu.

glosses.zh: 青黛：青黑色，像女子画眉用的颜料。
glosses.en: qīng dài: a dark blue-green, like the color women used to paint their eyebrows.

glosses.zh: 金阙：本来指黄金装饰的宫门，这里指庐山的金阙岩（又叫石门），两座山峰相对像门。
glosses.en: jīn què: a golden palace gate; here it is the Golden Gate Cliff (Stone Gate) of Mount Lu, two peaks facing each other like a gate.

glosses.zh: 银河倒挂三石梁：瀑布从三石梁上落下来，像天上的银河倒挂下来。三石梁：庐山上横跨的三道石梁。
glosses.en: yín hé dào guà sān shí liáng: a waterfall pours from the Three Stone Bridges like the Milky Way hanging upside down. The Three Stone Bridges are rock ridges on Mount Lu.

glosses.zh: 香炉：香炉峰，庐山的一座山峰，形状像香炉。
glosses.en: xiāng lú: Incense Burner Peak, a peak of Mount Lu shaped like an incense burner.

glosses.zh: 回崖沓嶂：弯弯曲曲的山崖，层层叠叠的山峰。
glosses.en: huí yá tà zhàng: winding cliffs and peaks piled one behind another.

glosses.zh: 凌苍苍：高高地升到青天上。凌：升上、超过。苍苍：青天。
glosses.en: líng cāng cāng: rising high into the blue sky. Líng means to rise above; cāng cāng is the blue sky.

glosses.zh: 吴天：庐山一带古代属于吴国地方，所以这里的天空叫吴天。
glosses.en: wú tiān: the sky of Wu. The land around Mount Lu once belonged to the state of Wu.

glosses.zh: 壮观：尽情观看雄伟的景色。
glosses.en: zhuàng guān: taking in the grand view.

glosses.zh: 动风色：风起云动，天色变化。
glosses.en: dòng fēng sè: the wind rises and the colors of the sky change.

glosses.zh: 白波九道：传说长江流到浔阳（今江西九江）一带分成九条支流。白波：白色的浪花。
glosses.en: bái bō jiǔ dào: legend says the Yangtze split into nine streams near Xunyang (today's Jiujiang, Jiangxi). Bái bō means white waves.

glosses.zh: 流雪山：白浪翻滚，像流动的雪山。
glosses.en: liú xuě shān: the white waves roll like moving snow mountains.

glosses.zh: 谣：不配乐、可以随口唱的歌。
glosses.en: yáo: a song sung freely, without music.

glosses.zh: 兴因庐山发：兴致是庐山引起来的。
glosses.en: xìng yīn lú shān fā: his delight was stirred by Mount Lu.

glosses.zh: 石镜：庐山东边有一块圆石，光亮得能照见人影，叫石镜。
glosses.en: shí jìng: the Stone Mirror, a round rock on the east side of Mount Lu so bright it reflects your face.

glosses.zh: 清我心：让我的心变得清净。
glosses.en: qīng wǒ xīn: makes my heart clear and calm.

glosses.zh: 谢公：南朝诗人谢灵运，他游过庐山，写过庐山的诗。
glosses.en: Xie Gong: the poet Xie Lingyun of the Southern Dynasties, who traveled Mount Lu and wrote about it.

glosses.zh: 苍苔没：被青苔盖住了。
glosses.en: cāng tái mò: covered over by green moss.

glosses.zh: 还丹：道家炼的一种仙药，传说吃了能成仙。
glosses.en: huán dān: an elixir made by Daoists, said to turn a person into an immortal.

glosses.zh: 无世情：没有了世俗的念头。
glosses.en: wú shì qíng: free of worldly cares.

glosses.zh: 琴心三叠：道家修炼的说法，指心神平和、修炼到很高的境界。
glosses.en: qín xīn sān dié: a Daoist phrase for a calm, harmonious mind that has reached a high stage of practice.

glosses.zh: 道初成：修道刚刚有了成果。
glosses.en: dào chū chéng: his Daoist practice has just begun to succeed.

glosses.zh: 芙蓉：荷花。
glosses.en: fú róng: a lotus flower.

glosses.zh: 朝玉京：去朝拜玉京。玉京：道教说的天帝住的地方。
glosses.en: cháo yù jīng: to go and pay respects at the Jade Capital, where the Daoist Lord of Heaven lives.

glosses.zh: 先期：事先约好。
glosses.en: xiān qī: to arrange a meeting in advance.

glosses.zh: 汗漫：传说中的仙人名字，也有“无边无际”的意思。
glosses.en: hàn màn: the name of a legendary immortal; the word also means "boundless".

glosses.zh: 九垓：九重天，天的最高最远处。
glosses.en: jiǔ gāi: the nine layers of heaven, the highest and farthest place.

glosses.zh: 卢敖：秦朝人，传说他到北海游历，遇见一位仙人，仙人说要和汗漫在九垓之外相会。这里借卢敖指卢虚舟。
glosses.en: Lu Ao: a man of the Qin dynasty. Legend says he met an immortal in the far north, who said he had a meeting with Hanman beyond the nine heavens. Here Lu Ao stands for Lu Xuzhou, who has the same surname.

glosses.zh: 太清：道家说的天空最高处，神仙住的地方。
glosses.en: tài qīng: in Daoism, the highest heaven, where immortals live.

translation.zh: 我本来就像楚国的狂人接舆，
translation.en: I am like Jieyu, the Madman of Chu,

translation.zh: 唱着凤歌嘲笑孔子。
translation.en: singing the phoenix song and laughing at Confucius.

translation.zh: 手里拿着绿玉做的手杖，
translation.en: With a green jade staff in my hand,

translation.zh: 早上告别了黄鹤楼。
translation.en: I left the Yellow Crane Tower one morning.

translation.zh: 为了到五岳寻找神仙，我不怕路远，
translation.en: I never mind the distance in seeking immortals on the great mountains;

translation.zh: 我这一辈子就喜欢游名山。
translation.en: all my life I have loved to wander famous peaks.

translation.zh: 庐山高高挺立在南斗星旁边，
translation.en: Mount Lu rises tall and lovely beside the Southern Dipper;

translation.zh: 九叠屏像彩色锦缎一样展开，
translation.en: the Nine-Fold Screen spreads out like colored brocade,

translation.zh: 山影倒映在明亮的湖中，泛着青黑色的光。
translation.en: and its shadow falls in the bright lake, glowing dark blue-green.

translation.zh: 金阙岩前，两座山峰高高耸立，
translation.en: Before the Golden Gate, two peaks stand tall;

translation.zh: 瀑布从三石梁落下，像银河倒挂。
translation.en: from the Three Stone Bridges a waterfall hangs like the Milky Way.

translation.zh: 它和香炉峰的瀑布远远相望，
translation.en: It faces the Incense Burner falls from far away,

translation.zh: 弯弯的山崖、层层的山峰直上青天。
translation.en: and winding cliffs and piled peaks climb into the blue sky.

translation.zh: 青翠的山影和红霞映着早上的太阳，
translation.en: Green shadows and red clouds glow in the morning sun;

translation.zh: 鸟儿飞不到头，吴地的天空那么辽阔。
translation.en: the sky of Wu stretches so far that birds cannot reach its end.

translation.zh: 登上高处，尽情看天地之间的壮丽景色，
translation.en: I climb high and gaze at the grand sights between heaven and earth;

translation.zh: 大江茫茫，一去不回。
translation.en: the great river flows on and on and never comes back.

translation.zh: 万里黄云随风变幻，
translation.en: Yellow clouds for ten thousand li shift with the wind,

translation.zh: 九道江水翻着白浪，像流动的雪山。
translation.en: and the nine streams roll with white waves like moving snow mountains.

translation.zh: 我喜欢为庐山作歌，
translation.en: I love to make songs for Mount Lu;

translation.zh: 我的兴致是庐山引起来的。
translation.en: it is Mount Lu that stirs my delight.

translation.zh: 闲来照照石镜，让我的心变得清净；
translation.en: At leisure I look into the Stone Mirror and my heart grows clear;

translation.zh: 谢灵运走过的地方，已经被青苔盖住了。
translation.en: the paths Xie Lingyun walked are buried under green moss.

translation.zh: 我要早早服下仙丹，抛开世俗的念头，
translation.en: I will take the elixir early and leave worldly cares behind;

translation.zh: 心神平和，修道刚刚有成。
translation.en: my mind is calm and harmonious, and my Daoist practice has begun to succeed.

translation.zh: 远远看见仙人在彩云里，
translation.en: Far away I see immortals among the colored clouds,

translation.zh: 手拿荷花去朝拜玉京。
translation.en: lotus flowers in hand, on their way to the Jade Capital.

translation.zh: 我已经和仙人汗漫约好在九重天上相会，
translation.en: I have already arranged to meet Hanman above the nine heavens,

translation.zh: 希望接上你这位“卢敖”，一起去遨游太清。
translation.en: and I hope to bring you, my Lu Ao, to roam the highest heaven with me.

background.zh: 一般认为这首诗写于唐肃宗上元元年（760年）。前一年，李白因为卷入永王李璘的事被流放夜郎（在今贵州一带），走到半路遇到大赦，被放了回来。他回到江夏（今湖北武汉）一带，又来到江西的庐山游览。卢虚舟是他的朋友，当时做过殿中侍御史，侍御史就是负责检查官员是否犯错的官。李白把这首写庐山的长诗寄给了他。
background.en: This poem is usually dated to 760. The year before, Li Bai had been sent into exile to Yelang (around today's Guizhou) because he had been caught up in the affair of Prince Yong, Li Lin. Halfway there, a general pardon set him free. He went back to the Jiangxia area (today's Wuhan, Hubei) and then visited Mount Lu in Jiangxi. Lu Xuzhou was his friend and had served as a palace censor, an official who checked whether other officials did wrong. Li Bai sent him this long poem about Mount Lu.

author_note.zh: 李白（701—762），唐代大诗人，人称“诗仙”。他一生爱游名山，又喜欢道教，相信世上有神仙，还正式入过道门。这首诗写在他经历流放、年近六十的时候。他把对官场的失望，变成了对山水和神仙世界的向往。
author_note.en: Li Bai (701–762) was a great Tang poet, called the Immortal of Poetry. All his life he loved to travel famous mountains. He was drawn to Daoism, believed in immortals, and was even formally made a Daoist. He wrote this poem when he was nearly sixty, just after his exile. His disappointment with government life turned into a longing for mountains, rivers and the world of the immortals.

appreciation.zh: 这首诗像一次带着翅膀的登山。开头李白说自己是楚狂人，敢笑孔子，拿着仙人的手杖出发，一下子就显出他不在乎官场的狂放。中间是庐山的大画卷：九叠屏像展开的锦缎，山影落进湖里，瀑布像银河倒挂，红霞映着朝阳，连鸟都飞不到天的尽头。再登高一看，长江茫茫东去，黄云万里，白浪像流动的雪山，视野越来越大。最后他写照石镜、服仙丹、看仙人朝拜玉京，邀请朋友一起去天上遨游。从人间的山水一路写到天上的仙境，句子忽长忽短，气势奔放，读起来让人心胸开阔。
appreciation.en: The poem is like a mountain climb with wings. At the start Li Bai calls himself the Madman of Chu, bold enough to laugh at Confucius, setting off with an immortal's staff. Right away we see how little he cares for official life. The middle is a great scroll painting of Mount Lu: the Nine-Fold Screen opens like brocade, the mountain's shadow falls into the lake, a waterfall hangs like the Milky Way, red clouds glow in the morning sun, and the sky is so wide birds cannot reach its end. Climbing higher, he sees the Yangtze flowing endlessly east, yellow clouds for ten thousand li, and white waves like moving snow mountains. The view grows bigger and bigger. At the end he looks into the Stone Mirror, takes an elixir, watches immortals go to the Jade Capital, and invites his friend to roam heaven with him. From earthly mountains all the way to the heavens, with lines now long and now short, the poem sweeps along and makes the reader's heart feel wide open.
